successCriteria.description: LeaveListPage renders a navigation link to the request-leave form (target `/leaves/new`) above the existing list rendering, without altering the loading/error/empty/list branches.

App registers a route for `/leaves/new` that renders RequestLeavePage inside RequireAuth and passes leaveService, and the existing `/leaves/:id` route passes both leaveService and employeeService to LeaveDetailPage.
presentation/index.ts re-exports RequestLeavePage and RequestLeavePageProps alongside the existing page exports.
The composition root (main.tsx) injects employeeService, leaveService, and balanceService into App so every route's required services resolve at runtime.

constraints: No change to web/src/main.tsx is required; it already injects employeeService, leaveService, and balanceService into App.
The presentation module must remain free of any direct api-client dependency; services are injected from the composition root.
The request-leave form must be reachable only behind RequireAuth (authenticated session required).
outOfScope: Any change to RequestLeavePage form behavior, validation, or submission logic (Phase 3) is out of scope.
Any change to LeaveDetailPage rendering or its action handling (Phase 4) is out of scope.
Backend/service-layer changes (leave creation, persistence, transaction semantics) are out of scope for this wiring phase.

entityInvariants.invariant: RequestLeavePage accepts a leaveService of type ILeaveService and, on successful creation, navigates to the created request's detail view.
LeaveDetailPage accepts both leaveService and employeeService and resolves the request plus the current employee profile to compute available actions.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: Rendered only within RequireAuth; requires an authenticated session.
Must expose employeeService, leaveService, and balanceService so all registered routes receive their required dependencies.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The `/leaves/new` link target and route path must match exactly so the entry point resolves to the registered route.
RequestLeavePageProps must match the props interface declared by RequestLeavePage (leaveService: ILeaveService).
LeaveDetailPageProps must match the props interface declared by LeaveDetailPage (leaveService + employeeService).
AppProps must remain consistent with the services instantiated and injected in the composition root.

integrationPoints.why: The route and index re-exports wire this page into the app; its props contract is the integration surface.
The `/leaves/:id` route must continue passing employeeService alongside leaveService.
Composition root supplies the services the new and existing routes depend on.
